product_overview: PGmart is a trusted fashion and quality e-commerce store for browsing products, managing purchases, and completing secure account verification. It supports a modern shopping experience with product discovery, cart and checkout, and an admin management panel.
core_goals: Enable new users to register and verify their email with a 6-digit OTP
Provide fast and searchable browsing across a large fashion product catalog
Support a smooth cart, coupon, address selection, and checkout experience
Allow admins to manage products, banners, orders, users, and coupons from a dashboard

features.name: Account Registration & Email OTP Verification
features.description: Users can create an account with personal details, receive a 6-digit OTP by email, and verify the account to log in.
user_flows: POST /account/register with Name, Phone, Email, and Password -> Receive 200 with OTP generation confirmation -> POST /account/verify-otp with the correct 6-digit code -> Receive 200 with account verified and user logged in

POST /account/register with invalid or missing registration data -> Receive 400 with validation errors -> POST /account/verify-otp with an incorrect or expired OTP -> Receive 401 or 400 with verification failed response

features.name: Product Search & Browsing
features.description: Users can explore the catalog of 2400+ fashion products by category, subcategory, brand, and search keywords.
user_flows: GET /products with optional category, subcategory, brand, and search query parameters -> Receive 200 with matching product list and pagination data -> GET /products/{productId} for a selected product -> Receive 200 with product details and images

GET /products with an unsupported filter or empty result query -> Receive 200 with empty results or 400 with filter error -> GET /products/{productId} for a non-existent product -> Receive 404 with product not found

features.name: Shopping Cart & Checkout
features.description: Users can add items to the cart, choose a shipping address, apply promo codes, and complete checkout.
user_flows: POST /checkout/cart/items with productId and quantity -> Receive 200 with updated cart totals -> POST /checkout/coupons/apply with a valid promo code -> Receive 200 with discounted total -> POST /checkout/orders with selected address and payment details -> Receive 200 with order confirmation

POST /checkout/cart/items with an out-of-stock product or invalid quantity -> Receive 400 or 409 with cart update failure -> POST /checkout/coupons/apply with an invalid or expired promo code -> Receive 400 with coupon validation error -> POST /checkout/orders with no shipping address selected -> Receive 400 with checkout validation error

features.name: Admin Management Panel
features.description: Admins can manage products, banners, orders, users, and coupons through CRUD operations in the dashboard.
user_flows: POST /admin/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with admin session token -> GET /admin/products -> Receive 200 with product inventory list -> POST /admin/products with new product data -> Receive 201 with product created

POST /admin/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with authentication failed -> GET /admin/orders without an admin token -> Receive 403 with forbidden access -> DELETE /admin/coupons/{couponId} without permission -> Receive 403 with access denied
